text: Hello, I am Dr. Agent. Please describe the exact location of your sudden abdominal pain and whether it has radiated to any other area. Additionally, have you experienced any nausea, vomiting, or changes in your bowel habits?

speaker: Patient
text: 74-year-old male. The patient presents with sudden onset of abdominal pain around the umbilicus 16 hours ago, with recent history of hospitalization for an acute myocardial infarction a week ago. Reports several episodes of bloody loose bowel movements. Denies vomiting.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Ischemic Colitis

Based on your history of a recent heart attack and the sudden onset of abdominal pain around your navel accompanied by bloody loose stools, the symptoms strongly suggest ischemic colitis. Can you confirm if you have experienced any fever or chills since the pain began?
